text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to see the rare flowers that bloom on the mountain peak"—
At Lucky Lilac's request,
this happened when we climbed a nearby mountain on our way back from an outing.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Look at these flowers. Aren't they pretty? Fufu♪
I'm truly looking forward to seeing them with my own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pitter... patter...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Eep!? So cold...!
...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Shaaaa...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: No way, it's raining!?
choice_data_list: A-Anyway, let's take shelter under that tree!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, it was just a passing shower, so it stopped right away.
However, the mountain trail's condition had changed completely as a result...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Quite a lot of mud, huh.
I'll need to clean my shoes thoroughly when I get back...
choice_data_list: My feet are getting caught, it might be tough to walk...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, jeez! Seriously, the rain...!
It's such a downer, give me a break already...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh? Could that be Lala-san?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Oh my! What a coincidence bumping into you here!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that the truth.
What's Desire-san up to?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
With the landowner's permission, I'm gathering herbs here.
Brewing potions is a saint's duty, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
A potion... I see.
You're certainly working hard at it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I've heard that there are medicinal herbs
and flowers even at the summit.
I'm thinking of climbing up there."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That's right. If both of you are climbing as well,
would you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Uuu...! It's way muddier here
than on that last road...!
It's all squishy and gross...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Man, this really kills the mood...
...Maybe giving up and headin' home for today is the way to go...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Phew... This is quite a rough road. But that's exactly why... hehe. It's worth walking on!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh? Good for walking...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This must surely be a trial bestowed upon a saint!
'A true saint must never stumble in the mud'—
I feel like that is what I'm being told!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, who's the one that told ya?!
...Between this and that potion earlier,
she sure has a unique worldview as always...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Once I overcome this trial, I'll draw closer! One step closer to another world—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Kyaah!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Desire-san?! Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine... I just slipped a little.
Though... Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That only makes it more worth challenging!
The greater the obstacle, the greater the heights
I can reach as a Saint—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter what misfortune befalls me,
I will overcome it without fail!
On the name of the Saintess, Red Desire!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Desire-san...
choice_data_list: You took a fall, yet you still look like you're having fun.
You took a fall, yet you still look like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Ain't that the truth. I'd be pretty bummed out myself if I got that covered in mud.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
However... even with the same hardship,
if I change how I approach it—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Like—... you know.
You get this kind of muddy feeling during races too.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Losing footing in the post-rain mud.
Even so, enduring it, pushing forward.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...Aye. This path will be an 'ordeal' for me too. To endure and persevere, so I can blossom on the track—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Shall we keep movin' forward, Trainer?
—This right here is where we gotta give it our all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grimacing at the heavily muddied mountain path,
Lucky Lilac pushed her legs forward with all her might.
And finally—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Miss Lala, over here, over here!
Look, come see this!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —...! The flower I wanted to see...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The dew catches the sunlight and glitters so brilliantly...!
Surely, this must be a blessing for overcoming our trials!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, honestly. I'm so glad I gave it my all...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Desire-san.
To be honest, the rain had gotten me down, but if I think of this as a trial for me—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That was over in a flash!
A pathetic little muddy road like that's nothin'!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My! If I was able to be of any help,
I couldn't be happier. Ufufu♪
choice_data_list: Since we're here, wanna take a commemorative photo in front of the flowers?
Then maybe I could help pick some herbs as thanks?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great. Since we came all this way—
Desire, why don't you join us for the photo?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In that case, leave the pose to me.
I shall pour all my gratitude into the beauty of this land.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Then me too.
Striking the same pose as Desire-san. Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Right ya are. Desire-san,
mind if we lend a hand gatherin' medicinal herbs too?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a huge help! Once the potion is
ready, I'll give some to you too, Lala-san!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are ya sure?
I'm lookin' forward to it then.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Well, not that I'm planning to go dungeon-crawling or anything!
But who wouldn't be curious about what kind of potion Desire-san makes~!)
